items: 3 cups crushed vanilla wafers (12 oz box)

steps.title: Mix the crust
steps.body: Mix **3 cups crushed vanilla wafers** (12 oz box), **⅔ cup melted butter**, **1⅓ cups toasted sliced almonds** and **2 tsp almond flavoring**. Save ½ for topping.

steps.title: Freeze the base
steps.body: Press half of the mixture in a 9×13 pan and freeze.

steps.title: Layer the ice cream and jam
steps.body: Spread over frozen crust, in 2 rounds of ice cream tiered with jam, freezing between each round: **2 quarts vanilla ice cream** and **24 oz apricot jam**.

steps.title: Top and freeze
steps.body: Sprinkle remaining vanilla wafer mixture on top and freeze until serving.
